info.title: OpenAPI Flark
info.description: A sample API that uses a plant store as an example to demonstrate features in the OpenAPI specification

post.description: API that start a call using a pre-trained playbook.

get.description: Returns data about a specific call.
One page of calls for a single agent owned by the authenticated account. The body is an object with agent_id, agent_name, page, total_pages and calls, ordered by created_time descending.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: UUID of the agent. assistant_id is accepted as the same field. The agent must belong to the authenticated account.

parameters.name: assistant_id
parameters.description: Alias of agent_id. If both are sent, they must be equal.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Window start, UTC. YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. Must be sent with endDate. Maximum span 90 days.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Window end, inclusive, UTC. A date-only value includes that whole UTC day.

parameters.name: daysFromNow
parameters.description: Days back from now (UTC) when startDate and endDate are omitted. Default 15. Maximum 90.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One status, a comma-separated list, or repeated. Allowed: closed, silence-call, voicemail, busy,  no-answer, failed. When omitted, the query is limited to those same statuses.

400.description: Invalid agent_id, dates, status, page, or limit

404.description: Agent not found on this account

phone.description: The phone to call with country prefix (e.g. +34600000000).

playbook_id.description: The id of the playbook you want to use to make the call. You can get the list of playbooks using your dashboard (/playbook endpoint will be available soon).

version_id.description: Optional. The ID of a specific playbook version to use for this call. If not provided, the system will automatically use the version marked as 'production'. This allows you to test specific versions or use historical configurations.

voice_id.description: The number of the voice to use (values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) - Default 6.

voice_model.description: Choose from our speech models: - 'fast' (less latency, nice voices) or 'human' (our natural sounding voices - (beta)) - Default model: 'human'

language.description: The language used by Flark during the call (values: ES, EN, FR, DE, IT, PT, ...) - Default ES.

interrupt.description: If the user can interrupt to the IA during the call - Default false.

<custom_param_1>.description: A custom param like email, firstname, lastname, email, program_of_insterest, etc. Flark will use this param to personalize the call.

<custom_param_2>.description: A custom param like email, firstname, lastname, email, program_of_insterest, etc. Flark will use this param to personalize the call.

<custom_param_N>.description: You can add as many custom params as you want. Flark will use this param to personalize the call.

id.description: The id of a the call

success.description: If the call started successfully or not

message.description: The message explaining the result of the call initiation

page.description: Requested page as a string, starting at "1".

total_pages.description: Total pages as a string. "0" when nothing matches.

created_time.description: When the call was created, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in UTC.

from.description: Phone number that initiated the call.

to.description: Phone number that received the call.

status.description: Call status. One of: closed, silence-call, voicemail, busy, no-answer, failed.

success.description: Whether the call was marked successful.

output.description: Structured output. Shape depends on the agent.

data.description: Call parameters. Voice and model fields are removed.

playbook_name.description: Name of the playbook used during the call.

playbook_id.description: Unique identifier of the playbook used during the call.

version_id.description: The ID of the playbook version that was used for this call. If empty, the current playbook configuration was used (no version control).

status.description: Current status of the call, possible values include: 'ringing', 'open', 'closed', 'no-answer', 'voicemail', 'busy', 'recall-scheduled', 'wrong-phone-format'.

duration.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

transcript.description: Full transcription of the call in HTML format.

summary.description: Brief summary of the conversation during the call.

data.description: Parameters received to initiate the call.

success.description: Indicates whether the objectives defined in the playbook were met.

recording.description: Indicates whether the call was recorded.

created_time.description: Timestamp for when the call was initiated, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in UTC (Z). For example, a created_time of '2024-01-28 16:16:56' corresponds to '2024-01-28 18:16:56' in Spain (UTC +2).

error.description: If the call started successfully or not

message.description: The message explaining why the call initiation failed
